printedProse.1: O mighty man, why wilt Thou boast Thyself in hateful cruelty, When God Almighty is most kind, And ever merciful is He?
printedProse.2: Thy tongue deviseth wickedness, A weapon treacherous and keen; Thou lovest evil more than good, And falsehood in thy sight is clean.
printedProse.3: Since, O thou false, deceitful tongue, In deadly words Thou findest joy, The Lord shall pluck thee from thy place And all thy wickedness destroy.
printedProse.4: The good, confirmed in godly fear, The pride and folly shall confess Of those who make not God their strength, But trust in wealth and wickedness.
printedProse.5: I put my trust in God alone, For evermore I trust His grace, And like the trees within His courts I flourish in a favored place.
printedProse.6: With endless thanks, O Lord, to Thee, Thy wondrous works will I proclaim, And in the presence of Thy saints Will ever hope in Thy good Name.

ledgerRevisions.reason: Independent source review followed by a second reading: RFPA head is between B4 and G4 lines, original1912 head center y105 between B4 line94 and G4 line117; three-flat key makes Ab4. Initial hand-reading was wrong.

independentReviewer.statement: Both enlarged final bass-bar crops were independently reviewed. The q43 hollow head sits in the space above the A3 top line, with opposing stems on that same head: Bb3 for both tenor and bass. This corroborates bass Bb2→Bb3. The independent review also confirmed the q12 Thy- bass head as Eb3 from original staff calibration. The why Ab4 remains unchanged.
